name: Release notes
description: Notes written from what merged, and word to everyone who asked for it: every merge redrafts the open release's note, the note is ready when the release goes live, and publishing puts it on GitHub, a public changelog page and Slack, then drafts a reply to each person who asked, in the thread they asked in.

release_notes_slug.description: Public URL slug for the Release notes app (unique platform-wide; a suffix is added on collision)

changelog_slug.description: Public URL slug for the changelog page anyone can read (unique platform-wide; a suffix is added on collision)
